utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still haven’t heard where the repair drive is set up yet—do you know the location?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—I can find out the exact spot for you and let you know right away. If you want, I can also make sure the block gets the location posted clearly.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa—that would be great. Please let me know the exact setup spot as soon as you find it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still hearing things second-hand, but I’ll keep an ear out for anyone needing repairs and pass along names if I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure folks know tools and spare parts are especially needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll pass that along and keep listening for anyone who needs repairs or has spare tools and parts to share.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—if you can keep an eye out for tools and spare parts, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I’ll watch for tools and spare parts. I’ll let you know if I find anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—that means a lot. If you spot anything, just let me know and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely—once you bring the list, I’ll take a look in my shed and gather what I can. I may need a reminder, but I’m happy to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren. I’ll bring the list, and if you can, just give me a quick reminder later so I don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course, Hana—I’ll remind you later, and just bring the list when you can. I’ll check my shed for tools once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still checking the school notices, but I’ll let you know as soon as I find out where it’s being set up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye. I’ll keep an eye out too, and I’ll bring my toolbox and some duct tape just in case.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah—I'll let you know as soon as I hear the location.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, seems like they did pretty well—good turnout and plenty of hands. I’m glad folks pitched in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, that was a relief. If you want, I can help gather the list of broken things and we can match each one to someone who can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a big help, Uli. I can bring a few tools and we can start matching folks up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear. I’m glad the neighborhood came through for them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to hear. Do we still need a few more volunteers, or are we set to start?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think we could still use a few more hands, just to be safe. I’ll ask around a bit more when I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll have that small box ready for you later, then. Thanks for helping get it over there safely.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll let folks know the repair drive still needs a hand, and I’ll point you toward the porch step when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Much obliged, Vik. I’ll have it by the porch step later, nice and tidy.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing—what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Sam! Folks are dropping off tools and spare parts by the community hall, and it’s really picking up nicely.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I can help sort the tools by type and carry the paint and boxes to the garage—just point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven’t heard the confirmed details yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as I do. It’s best to wait on the start time and drop-off spot until then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — just ping me when it’s confirmed and I’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Will do — I’ll let you know as soon as the time and drop-off spot are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what do you still need fixed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring the old charger and spare cables if you’ve got them. A busted phone is helpful too if you can find it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll bring the old charger, spare cables, and see if I can find a busted phone too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Noah—thank you. Those will be really helpful for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll drop them off soon. Just let me know where to leave them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo—just leave them by the front porch, and I’ll make sure they get put to good use.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me. Let me know the time and drop-off spot once it’s set, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds great—I'll send the time and drop-off spot as soon as it's set. Thanks for pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Much obliged, Dane. I’ll keep an eye out and be ready when you send it over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning around 9 should work for me. I can check the school notices and let you know as soon as I find out where the repair drive is set up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—just let me know the drop-off spot when you can. I can bring the charger, spare cables, and maybe that busted phone too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I’ll check the school notices and let you know the drop-off spot as soon as I find it. Saturday at 9 still works on my end.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That’d help a lot—bring them by whenever you can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Leo—I’ll bring the tools by soon and help get folks sorted.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, Gus—thanks. Just swing by when you can and we’ll get everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: What can I do to help with the repair drive? Just point me to the task and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Sam—could you start by gathering names of broken items and, if you know them, who in the block might be able to fix each one?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll start gathering the broken items and matching them to neighbors who might fix them. I’ll bring you a list soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — we’re making a simple list of the broken things and who might be able to fix each one. Rosa said she’d sort the rest out once I tell her what’s broken.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — I’ve got it. I’ll make a simple list of the broken things and who might fix each one, then pass it to Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll make sure people know we’re especially looking for tools and spare parts. I’ll spread the word around the block right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn—that’s a big help. I’ll keep an eye on what comes in and make sure we’re ready for repairs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Glad to help — I’ll get the invites up and keep nudging folks for any tools or spare parts they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many more volunteers do you still need before you can start?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet—if you can share the number of volunteers and the start time, that would really help me keep the logistics straight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t have the exact count yet, and I’m still waiting on the start time too. I’ll check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, seems like they did pretty well—good turnout and plenty of hands. I’m glad folks pitched in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, so the repair drive is still on, right? Just let me know the confirmed time and drop-off spot when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I don’t have the confirmed time and drop-off spot yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds great, Dane — I’ll point you to the porch step and check on the faucet parts. Thanks for helping out with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that’s a big help. I’ll keep coordinating and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive and let folks know we’ve got the faucet and porch step covered for now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Tess—once you bring that list by, I’ll check my shed for tools and see what I can round up. I might need a reminder, but I’m happy to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great, Oren — I’ll bring the list by and give you a nudge if you need it. Folks are already dropping off tools and spare parts over by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Tess—I'll keep an eye out for the list and see what I can find in the shed. If you need another pair of hands at the hall, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Noah—could you bring your toolbox and a roll of duct tape if you have them? We’ll put them to good use.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can bring my toolbox and some duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey—that’ll help a lot. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still haven’t heard the exact drop-off spot for the repair drive—do you know where it’s set up yet?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the exact spot yet either—just that Rosa was going to start gathering names and repair needs from folks around the block.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—thanks. Once Rosa has the names and repair needs, I can help line up the drop-off spot when it’s confirmed.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
